home.intro: This is a simple app demonstrating a combination of tools & technologies. All pages have sound effects.
home.instructions: Click 'Frisbee Game' to begin. You will be led to Crash Site through narrative interaction.

frisbee.title: Space Frisbee
frisbee.instruction: Click the frisbee to throw it!

prompt.question: What should we do?
choices: It could be dangerous, we should be careful.
Let's reach in and find out!

lopQuestion.subText: It ate it all, and now all we have is this wet spoon! What do we do now?

lopResponse1.subText: Yeah! I have this cookie dough and a spoon. We can stick it inside and see if we get a bite.

lopResponse2.subText: Wait! It could be dangerous, I have this cookie dough and a spoon. We can stick it inside and see if we get a bite.

lopResponse3.subText: It could be hurt! We have to help! I have this cookie dough and a spoon. We can stick it inside and see if we get a bite.

warp.subText: That's not just wet, there's saliva on that spoon. We can learn so much from that!

lopHelp.subText: Cellina, the Genehome guide, you think you can help us?

cellinaSaliva.subText: Of course, saliva has cells in it!

cellinaCells.subText: Here's what I know. Cells make up all living things. They are like tiny building blocks that help organisms grow, survive, and function.

cellinaExamineCells.subText: We can use that saliva to take a closer look at the cells of what is in that rocket!

lopExamineSpoon.subText: I just see the saliva, how can we see the cells?

cellinaExamineSpoon.subText: Microscopes help us see small things, give me a minute.

cellinaMicroscope.subText: WAIT! We need to transfer the saliva to a microscope slide.

level1-008quiz.speech1-lop: Wait, is there an organelle only animal cells have?

prompt1.prompt: Animal cells have a ________________ that plant cells do not have.
responses: Animal cells have a lysosome that plant cells do not have.
Animal cells have a mitochondria that plant cells do not have.
Animal cells have a chloroplast that plant cells do not have.
Animal cells have a nucleus that plant cells do not have.

level1-008quiz.speech2-lop: So are there any organelles only plant cells have?

prompt2.prompt: Plant cells have _______ and _________ that animal cells do not have. (Choose 2)
responses: Yes, plant cells have ${a} and ${b} that animal cells do not have.

level1-008quiz.speech3-lop: I get it now, we can go back to the microscope to identify if this organism is a plant or animal.

level1_009CellTypeQuestion.question1: What type of cell do you see?
level1_009CellTypeQuestion.response1-correct: That's correct! This is an animal cell.
level1_009CellTypeQuestion.response1-incorrect: Hm, what organelles do you see? Hover over the cell to see the names of the organelles.
level1_009CellTypeQuestion.question2: How do you know this is an animal cell?

hint.body: Use your mouse to see the names of the organelles.

level1_009CellTypeQuestion.prompt: What type of cell is this?
level1_009CellTypeQuestion.explanation_prompt: How do you know what kind of cell this is?

cell-membrane.name: Cell Membrane
cell-membrane.description: The cell membrane is a barrier that controls what enters and exits the cell.

nucleus.name: nucleus
nucleus.description: The nucleus is a structure inside the nucleus that helps make ribosomes.

mitochondria.name: Mitochondria
mitochondria.description: Mitochondria are organelles that produce energy for the cell.

lysosome.name: Lysosome
lysosome.description: Lysosomes are organelles that break down waste and harmful substances.

cytoplasm.name: Cytoplasm
cytoplasm.description: Cytoplasm is the gel-like material inside the cell that contains organelles.

level1_010MeetSprinkles.lop1: Thanks Cellina! Let's go see if we can get the animal out of the rocket!
level1_010MeetSprinkles.cellina4: This animal is known as a kitten!
level1_010MeetSprinkles.cellina6: A kitten is a baby cat, an offspring of two parent cats.
level1_010MeetSprinkles.cellina8: That must be her name. She has tags that means she has a family.

choices: A family! That means she's missing, we should bring her home.
She must have gotten lost, we should return her.
Sounds like an adventure, let's return her to her parents!

level1_010MeetSprinkles.lop9: Yes! We should find her parents and bring her home.
level1_010MeetSprinkles.cellina10: I've heard some reports about missing offspring. We should start with those.
level1_010MeetSprinkles.lop11: But how will we travel when this rocket is broken?

level1_007AnimalCellPuzzle.title: Animal Cell
level1_007AnimalCellPuzzle.instructions: Complete the puzzle to discover the parts of an animal cell.

functions.lysosome: This is a Lysosome. It breaks down and digests waste material.
functions.cell-membrane: This is the Cell Membrane, a barrier that controls movement in and out of the cell.
functions.mitochondria: This is a Mitochondria. It makes energy from food.
functions.nucleus: This is the Nucleus. It stores DNA.
functions.cytoplasm: This is the Cytoplasm. It is a jelly-like fluid that fills the cell.

level1_007AnimalCellPuzzle.completed: Good job! Let's go double check some things.

level1_007AnimalCellLabels.title: Animal Cell
level1_007AnimalCellLabels.instructions: Now that we've learned the organelles in the animal cell, let's review. Draw a line connecting each to its function.
level1_007AnimalCellLabels.controlCenter: The control center of the cell that holds DNA and directs cell activities.
level1_007AnimalCellLabels.borderProtection: A border that protects and controls movement in and out of the cell
level1_007AnimalCellLabels.wasteDigestion: Breaks down and digests waste material.
level1_007AnimalCellLabels.jellyFluid: A jelly-like fluid that fills the cell

level1_007PlantCellPuzzle.title: Plant Cell
level1_007PlantCellPuzzle.instructions: Complete the puzzle to discover the parts of a plant cell.

functions.chloroplast: This is the Chloroplast. It uses sunlight to create food.
functions.cell-membrane: This is the Cell Membrane, a barrier that controls movement in and out of the cell.
functions.mitochondria: This is a Mitochondria. It makes energy from food.
functions.nucleus: This is the Nucleus. It stores DNA.
functions.cytoplasm: This is the Cytoplasm. It is a jelly-like fluid that fills the cell.
functions.cell-wall: This is the Cell Wall. It provides structure and support cell

level1_007PlantCellLabels.controlCenter: The control center of the cell that holds DNA and directs cell activities.
level1_007PlantCellLabels.borderProtection: A border that protects and controls movement in and out of the cell
